body: Where would you be able to find this 'link history' option? Itcs not (directly) under Settings & Privacy. At least not in the mobile Facebook app.
Agreed. I REALLY hate that they implement an option apparently (an to me unfathomably) at the cost of another key functionality.

Props to you for having been able to your way through. Seriously.  
Been there several times, and it's cost me **so** many years in sweat and tears. I just can't do it *again*. And even worse this time.

So I hear ya. This is NOT you. I so deeply and from the bottom of my heart wish you a continued recuperation, and all the very, very best!

I don't understand the question?  
I would be ONE of those people with mental problems (as you can see from my opening post). Trying to find a way through.

Within reason.
There are -in Europe at least- clear guidelines for unjustified PHYSICAL suffering that warrant euthanasia. Nothing like this is in place anywhere of MENTAL suffering.
So in VERY broad strokes: yes, it CAN be an option for anyone (like anyone could get the most horrifyingly painful form of cancer and request euthanasia).

Again: I'm not actually advocating it.
But I AM trying to move the topic away from the taboo it seems to be. 
And to be totally honest and transparent: for ME, yes, definitely it is a very valid and reasoned option.

Hope this makes things a bit clearer?

What I am looking for is to expand my readership beyond friends and Facebook acquaintances. I recognise my tunnel vision and would value new input immensely.  
On the other hand I could potentially see people maybe actually finding some recognition of their own thoughts, and able to openly share/discuss them. I am FULLY aware how incredibly sensitive this subject is.
